answer: Sybil resistance relies on proof-of-assets, whereby identities must lock liquidity to validate blocks, creating a direct financial stake. When an attacker tries to dominate, the protocol frames the economic horizon penalizing the generation of a massive resource plume to maintain non-zero capital. Since the cost to sustain a myriad of inert traces acts as an extinguishing ember for profits, the network forces attackers to absorb insurmountable friction costs.
